# GroomLocal

> The Pacific Northwest's dog and cat grooming directory. Find groomers in Washington and Oregon by city, service, and specialty.

## About

GroomLocal helps pet owners find dog and cat groomers across the Pacific Northwest. The directory lists more than 1,100 grooming businesses in over 200 cities across Washington and Oregon. Listings are compiled from public sources; a business shows an "Owner Confirmed" badge once its owner has claimed and reviewed it.

## Services Offered by Listed Groomers

- Full Groom (bath, haircut, nail trim, ear cleaning, styling)
- Cat Grooming (lion cuts, sanitary trims, feline-specific)
- Nail Care (trimming, grinding, pawdicure)
- Dog Bath (bath & brush, premium shampoos, blow-dry)
- Mobile Grooming (at-home, fully equipped vans)
- Self-Wash (DIY stations with pro-grade equipment)
- Teeth Cleaning (non-anesthetic dental care)
- Deshedding (undercoat removal treatments)
- Ear Cleaning (cleaning, hair removal)
- Puppy Grooming (first groom, socialization)
- Flea Treatment (medicated baths)
- Hand Stripping (wire-coated breed technique)
- Creative Grooming (pet-safe coloring, artistic styling)
- Boarding & Daycare

## Major Cities Covered

### Washington
Seattle, Tacoma, Bellevue, Olympia, Spokane, Vancouver, Kent, Renton, Federal Way, Everett, Kirkland, Redmond, Auburn, Puyallup, Lakewood, Lynnwood, Bremerton, Kennewick, Richland, Yakima

### Oregon
Portland, Eugene, Salem, Bend, Medford, Beaverton, Hillsboro, Gresham, Lake Oswego, Tigard, Corvallis, Albany, Springfield

## For Groomers

Every listing is free. Owners can claim their listing to manage details, photos, and inquiries. Free and Sponsored listings show the same Owner Confirmed badge; the badge is never for sale.

- Free listing ($0): claim and edit your profile, add photos, receive inquiries, Owner Confirmed badge
- Sponsored ($49/mo, or $41/mo billed annually): a clearly labeled spot in the Featured section at the top of your city page, limited to three per city. Payment never changes your badge or your position in the regular list.

Pricing details: https://groomlocal.com/pricing
Claim or add a listing: https://groomlocal.com/for-groomers
